one_line_thesis: NuScale is a pre-revenue SMR licensor with the only NRC-certified modular reactor design at commercial scale and $836 million of cash on the balance sheet.

deep_dive.executive_summary: NuScale is a pre-revenue SMR licensor with the only NRC-certified modular reactor design at commercial scale and $836 million of cash on the balance sheet. Revenue today is engineering fees to Fluor, not electricity sales. The stock is a deployment option on international partnerships such as ENTRA1 and Romania Doicesti, not a utility dividend. At ~$15 per share we expect 2.2% per year over seven years on our base payoff path, below our accumulate hurdle. Moat unproven. Dhando none. Stance watch.
